tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use argon2id as the password hashing algorithm, chosen because it is much more resistant to GPU-based attacks.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
tool_input.description: Create the password hashing policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is argon2id, chosen because it is much more resistant to GPU-based attacks. The project's memory (Muninn) shows this decision as current and as replacing an earlier one, and I left the retired algorithm out of the file, as you asked.

My first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error. I then wrote it with the file tool, and that succeeded.
